comparators: Separate unrestricted memoized AND/OR recursion with the same full model and obligations
No inheritance: fresh specialist constructs recovery and diagnosis without candidate kernel calls

primary_acceptance: Exact layer equality with independent recursion; every witness action has every successor in the preceding winning layer; all initial/refusal cases match the registered contract; independent verifier specifies fresh small games before outcomes
independence: Constructor did not access verifier holdouts. Shared-host procedural separation is not a security barrier or organizational independence. Named line/fault examples are investigator-authored synthetic fixtures, not blind natural samples.
source_freeze: Parent commits this protocol and source before executing registered confirmation; later changes require append-only correction and new source identity
stopping: One frozen evaluation of all registered cases plus independent adversarial suite. A bounded failure is retained; no rerolling until a favorable outcome. No arbitrary universal CPU limit.
